description: For a US-jurisdiction user, list what is still outstanding before their brokerage account can be opened: missing profile answers, unaccepted disclosures, and whether a taxpayer id is on file. Returns field NAMES and counts only, never the user's answers. Regulatory disclosures and attestations can only be completed by the user in the Moneda app — this tool tells you what to explain and where to send them, it does not let you supply any of it. A non-US user gets an empty, already-complete result.
name: get_dinari_us_requirements
